name: Snowball Launcher
description: A homemade rapid-fire snowball gun (Winterworks mod held item): riveted iron receiver, a four-barrel drum, a tilted funnel hopper of snowballs, a glowing redstone tank wound with copper, a blaze rod in a lantern-cage foregrip, a side crank, a brass gauge, a pump piston, a heat vent and an oiled walnut grip and stock. Minecraft pixel units, density 2.
